_about: The sound libraries, one per plan. tools/build-libraries.py turns each into <id>-<version>.zip with a manifest.json (sounds: tools/sounds-vcsl.py, IRs: tools/make-irs.py, pad loops: tools/make-pads.py); .github/workflows/libraries.yml builds and publishes them. Raise a library's version when its content changes.

libraries.title: Central Keys Library
libraries.summary: Two grand pianos (Steinway B and Kawai), an upright, FM pianos, a clavisynth and a harpsichord; pipe, quiet and positive organs; vibraphone, marimba, xylophone, glockenspiel, bells and hand chimes; nine pads (warm, air, choir aah / ooh, shimmer, strings, glass, swell, worship) - with worship-ready presets.

libraries.title: Central Instrument Library
libraries.summary: Four drum kits (studio, rock, unruly, brushes); hollowbody, archtop and clean electric guitars; upright (plucked and bowed), jazz and hollowbody basses; alto and baritone saxes and a sax section; harps, kalimbas, recorders, harmonicas, saxello, ocarina, world instruments and percussion kits - with presets to play from keys or your instrument.

libraries.title: Central Plugins Library
libraries.summary: Ambient drone and transitions (risers, a downlifter, swells, reverse cymbals, an impact) as sounds, and mix-ready boards built from the Central Plugins effects: ambient and rhythm electric, acoustic and bass channel strips, pad wash, shimmer keys and piano polish.

libraries.title: Central Pedals Library
libraries.summary: 28 cabinet and acoustic-body impulse responses for the IR loader (7 guitar cabinets with centre, edge and room microphones, 3 bass cabinets, 4 acoustic bodies) and pedalboards that use them: worship crunch and lead, edge delay, vintage and modern stacks, fuzz walls, tremolo combos, bass rigs and acoustic bodies.

libraries.title: Central Pads Library
libraries.summary: 12 pads for the pad pedal in all 12 keys - warm, air, choir aah, choir ooh, shimmer, strings, glass, swell, worship, ambient drone, deep and heaven. Each is a seamless stereo loop of the key's chord, played as recorded (no pitch shifting). Comes with every other plan too.
